# Learn AI by Building: companion repository

> Code, templates and guides for the book "Learn AI by Building: Find Out Why AI Agents Fail, and How to Build Ones You Can Trust" by Deepak Mukunthu. The book teaches product managers, developers and builders to debug and build AI agents by checking the parts around the model (context, memory, tools, harness) before blaming the model. The book text is not included. Everything here is MIT licensed, and all example data is fictional.

The book's numbers come from deterministic simulators, so a reader on the tag book-edition-1 gets exactly the results the book reports. Agents helping a reader should read AGENTS.md first.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deepak-mukunthu/Learn-AI-By-Building/main/README.md): what's here and which path to take
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deepak-mukunthu/Learn-AI-By-Building/main/AGENTS.md): how to run things and how to help a reader
- [Chapter guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deepak-mukunthu/Learn-AI-By-Building/main/docs/chapter-guide.md): what to do in each chapter and what you should see
- [Projects](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deepak-mukunthu/Learn-AI-By-Building/main/docs/projects.md): every open-source project the book uses, with setup and common problems
- [Assistant prompts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deepak-mukunthu/Learn-AI-By-Building/main/docs/assistant-prompts.md): ready-made prompts a reader can give an AI assistant, by reader path

## Code

- [Tiny agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deepak-mukunthu/Learn-AI-By-Building/main/code/tiny-agent/README.md): which version to run and the exercises
- [tiny_agent.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deepak-mukunthu/Learn-AI-By-Building/main/code/tiny-agent/tiny_agent.py): an agent loop in plain Python
- [check_agent.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deepak-mukunthu/Learn-AI-By-Building/main/code/tiny-agent/check_agent.py): its 8 checks
- [real_model.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deepak-mukunthu/Learn-AI-By-Building/main/code/tiny-agent/real_model.py): the same agent with a real model
- [Three agents, one loop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deepak-mukunthu/Learn-AI-By-Building/main/code/three-agents/README.md): a store, a bank, and an IT help desk run by the same loop, each a short file of settings
- [full/tiny_agent.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deepak-mukunthu/Learn-AI-By-Building/main/code/tiny-agent/full/tiny_agent.py): the agent with every Appendix D checkpoint applied

## Optional

- [AI Builder Lab](https://github.com/deepak-mukunthu/AI-Builder-Lab): ShopBot and the Sandbox, the browser exercises for Chapters 2 to 10. Its AGENTS.md lists the expected scores, and `node tools/report.js` prints them for any number of fixes.
- [test_real_model.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deepak-mukunthu/Learn-AI-By-Building/main/code/tiny-agent/test_real_model.py): offline test for the real-model version
